Some midrange/low-end phones may disconnect Bluetooth devices when CyanBridge is in the background or when you close the app. To keep your glasses connected, disable battery optimization for CyanBridge.
Open Recents, find CyanBridge, then use the app menu (often a long-press or tap the app icon) and choose Lock/Pin/Keep open. This prevents the system from clearing the app.
Battery optimization still appears to be ON. Please disable it, then tap "I Locked It" again.

Let\'s get you set up with your smart glasses. We need to configure a few things to ensure a stable connection.
Android often closes apps running in the background to save RAM. To avoid disconnections, please \"Lock\" CyanBridge in your Recents menu.

1. Swipe up from the bottom (or tap the Square button) to see recent apps.
2. Find CyanBridge.
3. Tap the icon at the top or long-press the preview.
4. Select "Lock this app" or the Lock icon.
Enables on-device automation primitives for the Local Agent, including optional screenshot capture when explicitly enabled in Local Agent settings.
Allow CyanBridge to find and connect to your nearby glasses.
Bluetooth permission is used only to discover, pair with, and communicate with your glasses. You can continue without allowing it now and grant it later when you connect a device.
AutoDiary, Auto Audio, Local Agent, and Pro features are optional and configured from Plugins.

Start with glasses connection, then explore Plugins whenever you are ready. Each plugin explains what it does and requests only the permissions it needs when you enable it. You can review or turn off features at any time.
Pick a starter model. CyanBridge will download it in the background while you finish setup.
Generation settings are selected automatically for the model and GPU acceleration is preferred. You can change or import models later in Local Models.
Review the code, report issues, and help improve CyanBridge for everyone.
CyanBridge is open source. Inspect the code to understand its behavior, report bugs or security concerns, suggest improvements, or contribute changes through GitHub.
AutoDiary can turn selected screen context into private daily facts and summaries.

Enable and configure AutoDiary later from Plugins. It can remind you to review daily facts, create summaries, and keep your settings in one place. CyanBridge asks for notification access only when you turn on a reminder.
AutoDiary can read screen text for local memory when you enable it from Plugins.

Screen text is stored locally for AutoDiary. Local Agent phone control reads the current interface only for actions you explicitly request. Apps in your blacklist are skipped. Review the Accessibility disclosure below before enabling this optional feature in Android settings.

CyanBridge uses Android Accessibility only if you enable it. Accessibility lets CyanBridge read text and interface structure from apps on your screen. It is used to save optional Screen Memory and to let the Local Agent tap, type, scroll, and navigate on your behalf. Screen content is stored locally for Screen Memory. When you request a Local Agent action, current screen content may be processed by the AI provider you selected, including a cloud provider if you chose one. Optional Local Agent screenshots require a separate setting and are never sent to a remote planner unless you separately allow remote screenshot upload. Apps in your blacklist are skipped. CyanBridge does not enable Accessibility automatically, and you can turn off Accessibility, Screen Memory, or Local Agent at any time.
CyanBridge will collect the recent Meta DAT state, errors, device details, and filtered logcat entries so the issue can be investigated.
Auto Audio can record glasses audio for transcription and daily summaries when enabled from Plugins.

Auto Audio records in 15-minute chunks, then transcribes them for optional summaries. You can review and delete recordings at any time. CyanBridge explains and requests notification or microphone access only if the options you choose need them.
Customize how the AI assistant behaves and what it knows about you.

You can customize the agent\'s personality (how it talks, its tone) and provide facts about yourself (your job, hobbies, family, preferences). This makes the AI more personal and helpful. You can edit these anytime in Settings.
Your Data Stays on Your Device
All your data is encrypted and stored locally on your phone.

Your chats, screen captures, recordings, and AI memories are encrypted using industry-standard encryption and stored only on your device. Future cloud sync options will be available with a Pro Subscription, allowing you to securely sync across devices. Cloud options are currently greyed out until you activate Pro.
Optional cloud features for power users.

You can use the ENTIRE app completely FREE with local models running on your phone (Qwen 2.5 1.7B, Whisper for transcription, etc.). No internet required!

Pro Subscription is ONLY needed for:
• Cloud AI models (API costs money)
• Cloud memory sync across devices

🔒 STEALTH MODE FIRMWARE (coming soon)
The upcoming Stealth Mode enables silent capture of audio, photos, and videos from your glasses. This requires a one-time payment of the Standard or Max Pro plan for the modded firmware flash. You can cancel your subscription afterward and keep Stealth Mode indefinitely!

🎁 FREE TRIAL
New users get a free 1-month Pro trial (rate-limited among all free trial users). Cancel anytime.
